content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NIT Agartala Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NIT Agartala Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Assistant and 1 for Technical Assistant cum Field Coordinator.

content_sections.text: Research Assistant: MA in English/ History/ Sociology/ Anthropology/ Library & Information Science Technical Assistant cum Field Coordinator: Graduate with knowledge of Meetei Mayek and Computer Skills

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Agartala Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 22-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the email application for the Research Assistant and Technical Assistant cum Field Coordinator posts is 22 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Research Assistant and Technical Assistant cum Field Coordinator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the Research Assistant post is MA in English, History, Sociology, Anthropology, or Library & Information Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for the Technical Assistant cum Field Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the Technical Assistant cum Field Coordinator post is a Graduate degree with knowledge of Meetei Mayek and Computer Skills.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Assistant post is Rs. 32000 INR plus 10% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Technical Assistant cum Field Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Technical Assistant cum Field Coordinator post is Rs. 25000 INR plus 10% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an Interview, which may be conducted in a hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q9. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete application along with required documents before the last date.

faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
